title: Ten projection involutions generate automorphisms of Hessian Enriques and Coble surfaces with Sylvester parameters (1,1,1,1,t) with nonzero t over algebraically closed fields of characteristic different from two and three
author: Daniel Allcock; Igor Dolgachev
work: The tetrahedron and automorphisms of Enriques and Coble surfaces of Hessian type
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.57
difficulty_reason: The authored proof constructs the common Coble–Mukai lattice and nef cone, analyzes Coxeter cusp orbits and their inequivalent scales, and recovers the intrinsic chamber tessellation to exhaust the surface automorphism group. This combines advanced surface geometry with hyperbolic reflection geometry beyond qualifying exams.

primary_locator.required_core: complete source quotient-resolution, common lattice and faithfulness, projection involution, nef cone and cusp-chamber reconstruction

source_scope_note: The selected problem is Theorem 4.2 for the exact Sylvester nondegenerate Hessian Enriques/Coble family with parameters (1,1,1,1,t), t nonzero, over an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from two and three. The complete author body retains the local surface, lattice, faithfulness, projection-involution, nef-cone and cusp-chamber reconstruction, including t=1. The original Coxeter drawing remains a figure-only asset with editable legend/caption, while the other author diagrams are editable XY-pic. Later group presentations and lattice/rational-curve models are unselected context.
